];

const rx = (list) => new RegExp('(^|[^a-z0-9])(' + list.join('|') + ')([^a-z0-9]|$)');
const BOARD_RULES = [
  [rx(['debt','credit','payoff','avalanche','snowball','consolidation']), 'Debt Free Journey & Payoff Strategies'],
  [rx(['401k','401\\(k\\)','roth','ira','retire','retirement','fire','pension']), 'Retirement Planning & 401(k) Calculators'],
  [rx(['mortgage','home','house','rent','refinance','refi','down payment']), 'Mortgage, Home Loans & Refinance'],
  [rx(['hysa','cd','compound','savings','emergency fund','deposit','apy']), 'High-Yield Savings & Compound Interest']
];
const mapKeywordToBoard = (kw) => { const k = kw.toLowerCase(); for (const [re, name] of BOARD_RULES) if (re.test(k)) return name; return 'Personal Finance & Wealth Building'; };

let boardsList = defaultBoardsRegistry;
try {
  const gs = $('Consolidate Boards Registry').first().json.boards || [];
  if (gs.length) boardsList = defaultBoardsRegistry.map(def => { const m = gs.find(b => b.BoardName && b.BoardName.toLowerCase() === def.BoardName.toLowerCase()); return m ? { ...def, ...m } : def; });
} catch (e) {}

let hist = [];
try { hist = $('Fetch Recent Queue History from Google Sheets').all().map(i => i.json); } catch (e) {}

// daily tracking
const nyDay = (iso) => new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' });
const today = nyDay(new Date().toISOString());
const todayCount = hist.filter(r => r.GeneratedAt && nyDay(r.GeneratedAt) === today).length;
// cron schedule guarantees exactly 2 runs per day; never abort scheduled runs

// keyword dedup (reads the TargetKeyword column that v2 now writes)
const recent = hist.slice(-cfg.recentKeywordWindow).map(r => (r.TargetKeyword || r.PrimaryKeyword || '').toLowerCase().trim()).filter(Boolean);
let pool = masterKeywords.filter(k => !recent.includes(k.keyword.toLowerCase().trim()));
if (!pool.length) pool = masterKeywords;
const kwObj = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
const targetKeyword = kwObj.keyword;
const kw = targetKeyword.toLowerCase();

let intentType = 'CALCULATOR';
if (rx(['vs\\.?','versus','or','difference','compare','comparison']).test(kw)) intentType = 'COMPARE';
else if (rx(['roadmap','plans?','blueprint','steps?','milestones?','journey','timeline']).test(kw)) intentType = 'ROADMAP';
else if (rx(['rules?','levers','framework','tips','ways','cheat sheet','hacks','pillars','strateg(?:y|ies)','budget(?:ing)?']).test(kw)) intentType = 'FRAMEWORK';
else if (rx(['rates?','table','matrix','checklist','schedule','audit','chart']).test(kw)) intentType = 'TABLE_CHECKLIST';

const targetBoardName = mapKeywordToBoard(targetKeyword);
const board = boardsList.find(b => b.BoardName === targetBoardName) || boardsList[0];
const pinId = 'FINPIN-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '') + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6).toUpperCase();
const base = kwObj.targetUrl || board.PreferredDestinationURL || 'https://finmatrix.cloud/calculators/debt-elimination-planner.html';
const destinationUrl = base + (base.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'utm_source=pinterest&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=' + (board.BoardID || 'pin') + '&utm_content=' + pinId;

return [{ json: {
  pinId, targetKeyword, keywordVolume: kwObj.volume || 1000, keywordKD: kwObj.kd || 15,
  intentType, keywordIntent: kwObj.intent || 'Commercial', pillar: kwObj.pillar || 'Personal Finance', pillarId: kwObj.pillarId || '',
  boardId: board.BoardID, targetBoard: board.BoardName, boardUrl: board.BoardURL || '',
  destinationUrl, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), testMode: cfg.testMode
}}];
